title: Borland on stage will neither confirm nor deny Project Rubik's Cube

tellings.quote: I can neither confirm nor deny that if you want me to answer that back question, ask for a damn receipt for the whistleblowers.

plain: Asked at a live stage event about something called Project Rubik's Cube, Dylan Borland said he could "neither confirm nor deny" it and told the questioner to "ask for a damn receipt for the whistleblowers." Borland tells this himself on an episode with Jeremy Corbell, the guest of that show, who is also named in the account; the telling says nothing more about what the project is.
